name: Claws and Paws Pet Resort
tagline: Where every dog comes home worn out happy.
brandNarrative: Claws and Paws Pet Resort isn't your typical kennel — it's Nick's home, and that makes all the difference. Dogs who come through the door at 862 NW Oak Ave aren't crated in a commercial facility; they're lounging in a real living room, romping in a securely fenced backyard, and going on actual walks through Corvallis trails and drives around town. Customers like Tracy S. say their dogs come home 'worn out and happy,' making evenings peaceful — and that's exactly the point. This is dog care designed around how dogs actually thrive: in a home, with people who love them.
ownerStory: Nick — the heart and sole operator behind Claws and Paws Pet Resort — didn't set out to build a business in the traditional sense. He opened his home in Corvallis to dogs who needed somewhere safe, stimulating, and genuinely loving while their families were away. Every reviewer mentions him by name, and every reviewer says the same thing: he clearly loves dogs. He walks them on wooded trails and wetland boardwalks, plays fetch in the backyard, takes them on car rides, and treats each dog like it belongs there. Whether it's Mollie the regular daycare attendee or Luna the visiting dwarf German shepherd passing through on vacation, Nick remembers them, cares for them, and sends their families video proof that everything is okay.

stats.label: Open Every Day of the Week

faq.question: Is this a commercial kennel or a home-based daycare?
faq.answer: Claws and Paws is run out of Nick's home in Corvallis, which is intentional. Dogs are far more comfortable in a real home environment than a commercial kennel — they sleep on furniture, play in a fenced backyard, and get one-on-one attention rather than being crated in a facility.

faq.question: Will I get updates while my dog is staying with Nick?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Nick is known for sending photos, videos, and text updates throughout every stay. Multiple customers have specifically called this out as one of the things they love most — you'll never be left wondering how your dog is doing.

faq.question: Do you accept dogs of all sizes?
faq.answer: Yes! Past guests have included a 40-pound retriever mix, heeler-mix brothers, a dwarf German shepherd, and a large husky. Nick welcomes dogs of varying sizes and temperaments and introduces them thoughtfully to the group.

faq.question: Can my dog board for multiple nights?
faq.answer: Yes, overnight and multi-night boarding is available. Jennifer Scotti's dogs boarded for two full nights and came home 'happy, healthy, and ready to go home to bed.' It's a great option for weekend trips or longer travel.

faq.question: Is the yard safe and secure?
faq.answer: Yes — multiple reviewers specifically mention the backyard is securely fenced and a good size for dogs to run and play freely. Supervised group play happens there daily.

faq.question: How flexible is Nick with drop-off and pick-up times?
faq.answer: Very. Nick is open Monday through Friday from 6:30 AM to 7:00 PM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Multiple customers praise his flexibility with scheduling, especially for working pet parents with irregular hours.

brandColors.note: Forest green reflects the outdoor trail walks, natural wetlands, and backyard play that define this business's active, nature-connected personality. Warm amber/golden yellow mirrors the energy of happy dogs, tennis balls, and sunlit backyards seen throughout the photo set — and signals approachability, warmth, and trust, which are the core emotional drivers in every customer review.
